limits: One captured final binary SHA and the original Cargo path/logs establish the recorded same-binary assertion. Per-run binary/source receipts and a build-time whole-source/Cargo label manifest were not captured.
Exact world_hash before/temporary source leaves and computed patch are retained; whole compiled-source identity and whole-command wall durations are explicitly unavailable.
Gate field records environment presence only; its literal value and inherited complete process environment were not captured.
